subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word segment that can replace the underlined part in the sentence.

The two thieves divided the looted money __with themselves.__
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. between themselves .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"with themselves"** is incorrect because it does not convey the correct relationship between the thieves while dividing the money.
 
• The correct preposition to use when something is divided or shared between two people is **"between"**.
 
• **"Among themselves"** is incorrect because it is used when there are more than two people involved, but in this case, there are only two thieves.
 
• The phrases **"of themselves"** and **"off themselves"** are grammatically incorrect and do not fit the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *The two thieves divided the looted money **between themselves**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Between vs. Among:**

 
 
• **Between:** Used when referring to two people, groups, or things. Example: The agreement was signed between the two companies.
 
• **Among:** Used when referring to more than two people, groups, or things. Example: The property was divided among the three siblings.
